picks.title: What Strategy paid for its bitcoin, by year: 2025's $99,819 average is 14% underwater
picks.description: What Strategy paid per bitcoin in each year it bought, from about $16K in 2020 to $99.8K in 2025 and $78.3K so far in 2026, against bitcoin's $85.6K close on Oct 6, 2026.
picks.reason: Bitcoin fell below $60K this morning for the first time since July, which puts every Strategy buying year since 2024 ($85.4K, $99.8K and $78.3K averages) below today's price, even as Saylor defends the STRC buybacks.

picks.title: Neocloud stocks in 2026 (Dec 31, 2025 = 100)
picks.description: 2026 performance of six neocloud stocks (CoreWeave, Nebius, IREN, Applied Digital, TeraWulf, Cipher), rebased to Dec 31, 2025 = 100; by Nov 13 only Nebius (138) and TeraWulf (110) were above where they started the year.
picks.reason: Today's AI-spending selloff hit the neoclouds hardest, Nebius broke below $90, and Michael Burry put his CoreWeave and Nebius shorts back in the spotlight.

picks.title: Tesla drawdowns from its record close vs the Nasdaq-100
picks.description: Weekly drawdowns of Tesla and the Nasdaq-100 from their record closes since 2019; on Nov 6 Tesla was 26.9% below its record and the Nasdaq-100 13.6% below.
picks.reason: HSBC upgraded Tesla to Hold with a $359 target this morning, pricing in a possible SpaceX merger, while the stock fell with the broader tech selloff.

picks.title: 30-Day rolling Correlation: BTC vs NASDAQ
picks.description: 30-day rolling correlation between daily bitcoin and Nasdaq returns since October 2024; it climbed from about 0.15 in early September 2026 to roughly 0.67 to 0.75 in November.
picks.reason: Bitcoin is falling with tech stocks today, not hedging them: it hit about $58,800 as the AI selloff pushed the Nasdaq toward correction territory.

picks.title: SpaceX capex by segment (USD bn): the AI build-out dwarfs rockets and Starlink
picks.description: SpaceX capital spending by segment: AI (xAI and X) capex rose from $0.5bn in 2023 to $44.6bn over the 12 months to September 2026, against $4.8bn for space and $5.5bn for Starlink.
picks.reason: Reports today say lenders behind SpaceX's $40bn Nvidia chip financing want legal guarantees the GPUs stay on Earth, a reminder of how big the AI spending has become.
